current_milestone.title: Professional MA2 Implementation
current_milestone.active_objective: Use the lean Design Mode as the default product path: verified Knowledge/State and cached compact context -> one primary LIGHTING_DESIGNER call -> optional one delta revision -> ZEN Artistic Plan Compiler -> strict internal ShowPlan -> deterministic MA2 Builder -> readback. ARTISTIC_CUES_V0_1 is the default provider contract; ZEN owns backend metadata and strict schema. The historical full multi-agent role chain is explicit/research-only, not the ordinary song-programming default. Preserve FREE_ONLY routing, CODEX_ARTISTIC_INTERVENTION=NONE, Fixture 9999 protection, Group/XYZ state, and verified readback boundaries.

last_closed_task.result: The lean AI programming path executed successfully on the Test Show. Provider artistic intent used ARTISTIC_CUES_V0_1, ZEN compiled strict zen.show_plan.v0.1, Sequence 2 was created and assigned to Executor 2.002 with six cues, MA2 programming readback passed, Sequence 301 / Executor 2.001 remained untouched, Phase A was not rerun, Groups and XYZ were not modified, Fixture 9999 was untouched, no paid provider was used, and CODEX_ARTISTIC_INTERVENTION=NONE. The generic compiler has since been refactored so SHEESH-specific six-cue labels live at the experiment boundary rather than in the compiler.

next_acceptance_gate.why_it_matters: The default product path must stay lean enough for free-provider quota while preserving artistic quality. The compiler is now song-agnostic and the full historical role chain is no longer default. Verify the refactor on the Windows runtime, then add delta-first revision/context reuse without reintroducing mandatory Researcher/Rig/Position/Critic/Finalizer calls.
next_acceptance_gate.next_review_condition: Full suite, self-check and git diff --check pass on the real development machine; the generic compiler accepts non-six-cue plans; the SHEESH bounded runner still enforces its six-cue experiment locally; no MA2 writes occur during regression verification. Then implement one bounded delta-revision path that reuses cached compact context and performs at most one artistic provider revision call.

human_review_decisions.limitations: Authorization is limited to the fingerprinted current Test Show, this SHEESH/Stage View experiment and Agent-owned objects. It does not authorize Patch, Address, Fixture ID, Fixture Type, Fixture 9999, unrelated objects or production Show writes.
No numeric-ID tie-break, equal Group level, cohort saturation, Group participation count, or dimmer level may be promoted into Lighting Design knowledge or a production strategy.

The completed SHEESH_CURRENT_SHOW_REDESIGN_001 run and its six role artifacts remain unchanged. The old status=COMPLETE describes technical execution only; the owner rejected the design and it is not writeback-approved.

evidence_results.limitations: Fingerprint confidence is PARTIAL rather than a native Show UUID. Stage/3D screen appearance was not captured. Numeric geometry is evidence only and carries no inferred artistic or stage-axis semantics.

All roles completed, but Position placements exactly reproduce the scanned 64 available geometry records; no geometry change is proposed. Position prose assigns units/physical meanings not established by the snapshot. Coordinate axes/units, physical mounting and current-fingerprint capability profiles remain UNKNOWN. Critic reports severity BLOCKER. Schema/provenance validity is not artistic approval. Codex did not edit ZEN artistic output; no spatial writeback occurred.

MA2 software concepts, current-Show machine facts, and operator/venue facts are separate namespaces. Official MA2 documentation does not supply this Show's XYZ sign mapping or exact scanned fixture Pos units. Operator Pan/Tilt directions are scoped to this Test Show and do not establish any XYZ sign. The supported loopback FixtureType export path was gated by the different live scanner identity and did not run; profiles remain unavailable for the Phase A fingerprint. UNKNOWN and PARTIAL remain valid. A new ZEN revision must wait for sufficient independent, fingerprint-bound placement and capability evidence.

This explicit Test Show authorization closes the resource absence blocker for SHEESH only. It does not establish a permanent palette, Group-to-Color role, B3 production authorization, or a Color design rule.
Fixture COLOR capability and generic typed CALL_PRESET syntax do not establish a current Show Color preset, applicability, palette, role, or B3 authorization.
